verdict.rationale: Sprinto is a SaaS compliance platform, so full data export and portability is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack contains no documented bulk export, open-format download, or offboarding/data-portability capability. The only nearby items are a data-API page title, audit-ready reports and inbound webhooks, which are adjacent features and earn no credit. Community posts about contract termination concern billing terms, not data export, so they do not bear on this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
